<script module lang="ts">
  import { defineParticleMeta } from "$LIB$/registry/particle-metadata.js";
  export const meta = defineParticleMeta({
    components: ["calendar"],
    id: "p-calendar-12",
    interactive: true,
    responsive: false,
    title: "Calendar week numbers",
  });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Calendar, type CalendarWeekNumberProps } from "$COMPONENTS$/ui/calendar/index.js";
  const today = new Date(2026, 7, 28, 12);
  let date = $state<Date | undefined>(today);
</script>

{#snippet weekNumber(props: CalendarWeekNumberProps)}
  <th {...props}
    ><span class="inline-flex size-(--cell-size) items-center justify-center"
      >{props.week.weekNumber}</span
    ></th
  >
{/snippet}

<Calendar
  components={{ WeekNumber: weekNumber }}
  fixedWeeks
  mode="single"
  bind:selected={date}
  showWeekNumber
  {today}
/>
